title: Sunvault Climb - Morning on the Terraces
_note: Option B mood sibling, warmer/pastoral. gbc 4-voice band. overworld. Gentle Lydian-tinged D major (raised 4th = G#), 108 BPM, 4/4, 24 bars. More lyrical singing melody (less pure-arpeggio, more tune), the Lydian #4 lift for dewy Verdant wonder. Softer, slower glassy-bell arp — sun-vines and growth rather than sparkle. Rounder, gently bouncing bass. Lighter kit: soft kick + brushed hat, an easier stroll. Vesper motif sung lyrically with a Lydian raised note on the overshoot: rising leap A3->D4->E4, the overshoot glinting on G#4 (#4) before the gentle settle F#4->E4->D4. Growth, not urgency. Last bar A->D pickup voice-leads to bar 1.
